title: outdoor faux flowers
text: outdoor faux flowers. I purchased these for our Arizona landscape.... no water necessary.  They "say" they are UVA resistant and they show them in outdoor displays.  So I am hopeful they will be able to tolerate the AZ sun... they are a softer "plastic".... hope they don't melt.  I will, of course, update my review if new info would be useful.  Having said all of that... I have had numerous neighbors come by to touch them ("to see if they were real or not") and admire them.  The color is lovely - vibrant... fresh and healthy looking. They are not quite as "full" as shown in the photos... I have about 12 bunches in each pot.... just fyi. The blue ones are much more blue than their pictures show... less purple.. more blue... in case that helps.  I have included a couple of pics.  I do really like them and hope they have staying power!!
